pose: Seen from the front, upright, its face flat towards the viewer.

what: a knight's heater shield: a broad shield shaped like the bottom of a flat-iron, with a straight flat top edge, two square upper corners, and two sides that curve inward to meet in a point at the bottom. It is about as wide as it is tall. Its face is one smooth, slightly bulging sheet with a broad flat raised border all round and a row of rivets on the border. It has no boss.
colours: The whole shield is plain neutral grey steel with bright highlights and dark seams and no tint of colour in it, and its face is bare with nothing painted on it.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, its face flat towards the viewer.
must_show: straight flat top edge with square corners

what: a kite shield: a tall narrow shield shaped like an upside-down teardrop, twice as tall as it is wide, with a fully rounded half-circle top and long straight sides that taper down to a sharp point at the bottom. It has a raised rim with a row of rivets all round the edge, one small round boss high up in the widest part, and a single raised ridge running from the boss down to the point.
colours: The whole shield is plain neutral grey steel with bright highlights and dark seams and no tint of colour in it, and its face is bare with nothing painted on it.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, its face flat towards the viewer.
must_show: long taper to a sharp point

what: a tower shield: one huge flat slab of metal whose outline is a plain upright rectangle, twice as tall as it is wide. Its top edge is one straight level line. Its bottom edge is one straight level line exactly as long as the top edge. Its left and right edges are two straight upright lines. All four corners are sharp square corners, and the two bottom corners are just as square as the two top corners: the shield is the same width at the bottom as at the top, and its bottom is cut straight across like the end of a ruler. A thick riveted rim runs along all four edges. Inside the rim the face is one blank flat sheet of plain metal with nothing on it except one round dome boss in the very centre and two broad flat riveted bands crossing from side to side, one half-way between the boss and the top, one half-way between the boss and the bottom.
colours: The whole shield is pure colourless neutral grey, light grey in the highlights and charcoal in the shadows, exactly as it would look in a black-and-white photograph. Its face is bare with nothing painted on it.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, its face flat towards the viewer, its edges parallel to the edges of the picture.
must_show: four square corners, the bottom ones too
flat straight bottom edge as wide as the top
round centre boss and two bands
